meta.name: obsidian-skills-integrated
meta.description: 内容创作者与技术写作员在让AI撰写Obsidian笔记时，使用此官方技能可精准处理双链、Callout及Bases数据库语法，一键生成格式零破坏的Canvas画布与专业笔记，彻底解决AI破坏专属格式的痛点。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI生成格式正确的Obsidian笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI写Obsidian笔记但总担心格式被破坏
copy.tagline_en: Generate Obsidian notes with correct formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write Obsidian notes but worry about broken formatting

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Obsidian 官方语法写笔记：双链、Callout、Frontmatter 保持原样不被破坏，并可生成 .canvas 画布与 .base 数据库文件。
howto.when: 当你在 Obsidian 库内要求它写笔记、生成知识图谱或建数据库时接管；提出双链、Callout 等关键词时也会触发。

say.text: 用 json-canvas 生成三国人物关系图，按势力配色分组
say.note: 产出 .canvas 文件，需在 Obsidian 中打开

say.text: 用 obsidian-bases 建读书清单，按评分排序只看已读

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes notes in native Obsidian syntax: wikilinks, callouts and frontmatter stay intact, and it can produce .canvas boards and .base databases.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask it to write notes, build knowledge graphs or create databases inside an Obsidian vault.

say_en.text: Use obsidian-markdown to write a note with wikilinks and an INFO callout
say_en.note: Produces a .md note with links and callouts intact

say_en.text: Use json-canvas to map Three Kingdoms characters grouped by faction
say_en.note: Produces a .canvas file, opened in Obsidian

say_en.text: Use obsidian-bases to build a reading list sorted by rating, read only
